description.purpose: The seed hive of the organism: an empty graph and nothing else. Not one cell is checked in here -- the whole four-level stack arrives later, from the template library, through the five grow-*.json declarations next to this directory.
description.use_when: As the --root of a colony that is grown rather than checked in.
description.not_in_scope: No shell, no organisation, no member, no assistant, no channel: none of that is written here, all of it is instantiated.
